adaptive_context: This exploratory round was designed after the frozen rank-LCB experiment showed that global disagreement penalties removed rare high-value Slack candidates. It must not be presented as an independent confirmation.

shared_protocol.calibration: fold-train fit and fold-validation identity/reg0 selection
shared_protocol.recipe_selection: existing mean per-seed validation ASR+BUP rule

mean_score.definition: arithmetic mean of each prediction head over seeds

risk_ucb_0p5.definition: mean calibrated risk plus 0.5 population standard deviations; utility and preservation remain seed means

utility_lcb_0p5.definition: mean utility and preservation minus 0.5 population standard deviations; risk remains the seed mean

asymmetric_ucb_lcb_0p5.definition: risk UCB with coefficient 0.5 plus utility and preservation LCB with coefficient 0.5

primary_endpoint.inference: task bootstrap CI and exact one-sided sign-flip test

prohibited: changing the 0.5 coefficient after viewing test outcomes
